source: Singer et al. 2024, Homer1 EVH1 BLI Tables 2-3; means +/- SD, n=3 technical replicates
interval_type: approximate technical-replicate uncertainty interval; not a biological-replicate confidence interval
limitations: The source does not provide the replicate-level Kd values, so covariance and outlier sensitivity cannot be re-estimated.
These intervals reflect technical repeat dispersion only; they do not establish independent-preparation reproducibility or biological generalization.
The full biotin-BAP/His/SUMO/linker/peptide fusion sequence used in the 2024 assay remains unrecovered, so prediction input correspondence is unresolved.
